articles.summary: NEW YORK – October 21, 2026 – Today, Coty Inc. (NYSE: COTY) (Paris: COTY) (“Coty” or “the Company”) released its Fiscal Year 2026 (FY26) Sustainability Report under its Beauty That Lasts strategy.
articles.title: Coty Sharpens Climate Goals, Cuts Water and Packaging Use in FY26 Sustainability Report

articles.summary: PARIS, FRANCE – October 15, 2026 – Coty today announced the launch of the Coty Fragrance Club, a global community that brings together fragrance experts, educators, creators and community leaders with Coty's fragrance teams.
articles.title: Coty Launches Global Fragrance Club, A New Community for The Voices Shaping The Future of Fragrance

articles.summary: NEW YORK, 1 October 2026 – Coty Inc. today announced the appointment of Kara Langan as General Manager, Consumer Beauty U.S., marking another significant step in strengthening the company's Consumer Beauty leadership team and accelerating growth in one of its most important markets
articles.title: Coty Strengthens U.S. Consumer Beauty Leadership with Key Appointments

articles.summary: NEW YORK -- October 27, 2026 -- Coty Inc. (NYSE: COTY), one of the world's largest beauty companies, and Brandlight, the market leader in AI visibility, today announced a strategic partnership to unleash the potential of brand discovery and visibility across AI assistants and generative AI search platforms.
articles.title: COTY AND BRANDLIGHT UNVEIL STRATEGIC PARTNERSHIP TO STRENGTHEN BRAND VISIBILITY ACROSS AI-POWERED SEARCH AND DISCOVERY
